start: Gym tab, My gym part; the gym's server has 0039 and enough timed check-ins; the gym is open (Tuesday 6 pm IST)

user_sees: Card 'How busy the gym is'
'Busier than usual right now' (or 'Quiet right now' / 'About as busy as usual')
'About 15 people checked in during the last 90 minutes'
must_not: A count shown when fewer than 5 checked in
A name or photo of anyone who checked in

steps.action: Look at the bars for today
user_sees: Day chips starting with today
Bars per hour, the bar for now in the gym colour
Hour words at both ends, such as '6 am' and '10 pm'
must_not: A bar for now on the wrong hour (phone clock not India time)

steps.action: Read the lines under the bars
user_sees: 'Quietest later today: 2 pm to 4 pm'
'From check-ins at your gym over the last 8 weeks. No names are shown.'
must_not: A quiet time earlier than now offered for today

start: Busy card on screen, today chip picked

steps.action: Tap the chip for another day, such as 'Sat'
user_sees: Bars for Saturday
'Quietest on Sat: 11 am to 1 pm'
must_not: The bar for 'now' lit on a day that is not today
'later today' words on another day

user_sees: The card asked again at once and redrawn
must_not: The picked day lost with no reason

start: The gym's server has no 0039, or the gym has few timed check-ins

user_sees: No 'How busy the gym is' card at all
must_not: An error box
A card with empty bars or 'About 0 people'

start: The gym's hours say it is closed right now (a holiday set by the gym)

user_sees: 'Closed right now'
No 'About … people' line
'Your gym is closed today.' for a day closed all day
must_not: 'Busier than usual right now' while the gym is closed
A quiet time offered later on a closed day

start: Busy card showing 'Quiet right now' at 5:58 pm

steps.action: Keep the Gym tab open past 6 pm
user_sees: The bar for now moves to the 6 pm bar within a minute
must_not: The 'now' bar stuck on 5 pm

steps.action: Leave the tab and come back after 6 minutes
user_sees: The level read again from the server
must_not: The level kept from an hour ago with no refresh
The card flashing away and back

user_sees: Only levels, counts and hours
'No names are shown.'
must_not: Who checked in, their names, photos or times
Another gym's numbers
